name: war_beasts_play
title: War beasts in play (D-129): the elephant, the war boar, the tarantula, the heron, the mantis, riders the race's spearmen
_doc: Each family's war beast as the game draws it (siege_models.gd BEAST): its riders are the race's own age-3 spearmen (rules roster war_beast: crew spear, crew_drop back), the tarantula goes alone; a centaur race's riders walk beside the elephant (the _wide sockets). Size references: a worker, a cavalry rider (romans large), a spider rider (spooky spiders large).
